upstream_plaza_fault_plan.scope: C05-C07 client-controlled T1 equivalent before any MOEX_COORDINATED fallback
upstream_plaza_fault_plan.method: dedicated router stays running; block only outbound MOEX T1 IP/ports; connector-router traffic stays intact
sequence: C05: connect and prove router reachable while upstream Plaza is unavailable; wait/no-send/no-current-stream
C06: remove the targeted block and prove the same connector detects upstream availability, fresh bootstrap and readiness
C07: with zero orders, reapply the block; prove readiness/command loss and no stale state, then remove it and prove fresh rebootstrap
safety: discover endpoints from protected runtime configuration without printing credentials
block only MOEX destination IP/port traffic for the dedicated router; never SSH or unrelated VPS traffic
schedule automatic rollback before applying any rule
record original network state and verify rollback after every case
begin with zero active orders and known position; defer Working-order transport loss until zero-order recovery passes
upstream_plaza_fault_plan.fallback: unsafe upstream injection: preserve offline; classify only live portion MOEX_COORDINATED with reason
